conventions_hash.description: Hash of the api-conventions.yaml this run consumed. Recorded so a pack can prove which conventions produced its API, and so a conventions change forces a re-derive rather than silently mixing two vintages.

unmapped.description: Surface items the rules could not decide. Each is routed to c8. Never guessed at here.

method_name.description: Present only when source_node_id is an SVC node.

client_side_only.description: NAV nodes and EL-derived RULEs the rules decided need no server round-trip in the target — a navigation outcome that becomes a client route, a rendered-condition that the client evaluates from data it already holds. This is a decision, not a gap: it is what stops each implementer from deciding it privately and differently. Every such item still appears here so that 'decided' is distinguishable from 'never considered'.

target_route.description: For a NAV node: the client route the legacy navigation outcome maps to, per api_conventions.navigation_semantics.

operation_id.description: Stable identifier for this operation, unique across the pack. Scenario bindings (c7b) reference it, so it must not change when unrelated operations are re-derived.

source_node_id.description: The legacy node this operation serves. SVC: a service method. SCR: a screen's read operation, supplying the fields and tables that screen renders. NAV: a navigation rule that needed a server round-trip rather than a client route. AUTHN: an authentication operation required by api_conventions.auth_semantics.

method_name.description: Present only when source_node_id is an SVC node.

derivation.description: How this operation was decided. c7 emits only 'mechanical'; c8's output is merged in as 'llm'. The distinction is kept in the pack so a reviewer can see exactly which endpoints involved judgment.

action_sub_resource.description: True when the operation is a non-CRUD action rendered per api_conventions.action_style rather than forced onto a CRUD verb.

page_size_source.description: extracted_from_screen means a SCR data_tables entry supplied it and therefore wins over the conventions default — this is the seam-crossing fact that keeps a page paginating at 10 from hitting an endpoint defaulting to 20.

roles.description: Copied verbatim from the AUTHZ nodes restricting this operation's source node, when carry_legacy_roles is true. Never inferred.

legacy_refs.description: The legacy surface this operation was derived from. An operation with no legacy_refs is invented, not derived.

openapi_fragment.description: A standalone OpenAPI operation object, merged into the application document by c9.
